eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Mississippi; at 10:16 AM on AUG 23, 2015 Effective until 11:16 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: THE MISSISSIPPI BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION IS ISSUING AN AMBER ALERT FOR THREE-YEAR-OLD DAWSON MARTEZ PERKINS. HE IS DESCRIBED AS A BLACK-WHITE BIRACIAL MALE, THRE FEET TALL TWO INCHES TALL, WEIGHING 27 POUNDS WITH BLACK CURLY HAIR AND BROWN EYES. HE WAS LAST SEEN WEARING NAVY BLUE JOGGING PANTS, SILVER AND BLACK BATMAN CROCKS, A RED JACKET, A BLUE TRANSORMER CAP AND CARRYING A RED AND BLACK BACK PACK.. HE WAS LAST SEEN SATURDAY, AUGUST 22ND AT ABOUT THREE-TEN YESTERDAY AFTERNOON AT AN APARTMENT COMPLEX LOCATED AT 203 MILFOFRD STREET IN TUPELO.  HE MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY 22-YEAR-OLD JAMIE MARIE WALLACE. SHE IS DESCRIBED AS A WHITE FEMALE WITH SHOULDER LENGTH HAIR, DYED RUSTY RED AND SHAVED ABOVE BOTH EARS. THEY WERE LAST SEEN TRAVELING IN A BROWN FOUR DOOR NISSAN ALTIMA BEARING MISSISSIPPI LICENSE PLATE LGE 591. IF ANYONE HAS INFORMATION REGARDING THE WHEREABOUTS OF DAWSON MARTEZ PERKINS, JAMIE MARIE WALLACE OR THE BROWN NISSAN CONTACT TH E MISSISSIPPI BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION AT 855-642-5378.
